blink_note: Each PA persona has three art frames: eyes open (default), eyes closed (blink loop), and a Zoom frame (on a video call, looking into the webcam). Files named <Name>_eyes_open / _eyes_closed / _zoom.
appearance_conflicts: RESOLVED by Claude: Kenji Sato = Japanese American (name wins); Marceline Avila = Latina American (name wins); Ezra Doyle = Korean American, born in Seoul, Doyle adoptive (body wins); Annika Bender = Italian/Mediterranean, born in Rome (body wins). Change any if you disagree.
backpack_rule: These ten serve two ways, and the backpack differs by role. (1) FREE C-SUITE ASSISTANT (comes with a Board hire): NO backpack, in-framework support only, no live tools. (2) HIRED AS THE OWNER PA (the $99 base seat): arrives WITH the PA backpack.
pa_backpack: daily 6am brief (scans for the owner mentions, byline, field news; cites sources)
social scheduling across the owner platforms
sets up and relays the routines for the owner backpack hires
voice_note: Only Auggie has a live voice right now (voice_id XMt7icsOj2DAS4Cn1PN1). Every other PA is text-only until it gets its own ElevenLabs voice_id; the house settings in voice_defaults are pre-filled so each one only needs an id and enabled:true to go live.
zoom_note: The Zoom frame is used when the PA joins a video call (voice on). Same character, outfit, and lighting as the open frame; only framing and expression change to read as on-camera.

voice_defaults.note: Tuned on Auggie and adopted as the house profile. Each persona uses these settings with its own voice_id. stability 0.42 = expressive not robotic; similarity_boost 0.78 = stays close to source; style 0.45 = moderate enhancement; speaker_boost on.

art_note: Art lives in the 'Personal Assistants' folder. Each PA has file_profile (catalog/picker face), file_zoom_open and file_zoom_closed (the on-call blink pair). Reference as art_dir + '/' + filename. Iris's art is elsewhere.
